description.value:
Prerequisite(s): Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Water)

Benefit: As long as you have an elemental (water) spell of 2nd level or higher in your known spells, have at least 2 MP in your MP pool, and a reasonable amount of water adjacent to you or on you, you can use a move action to raise a water shield that reduces damage from the next attack roll or negates fire/ice damage entirely. As a secondary benefit, you gain a +1 competence bonus to your caster level when casting elemental (water) spells.

system.requirements: Ability to cast 2nd-level spells, Elemental Focus (Water)
